summary: Full regression after Dashboard/SchematicDiagram/backend refactor. Backend: 42/42 pytest passing (auth, jobs CRUD, review, PDF export, attachments, KB, feedback, SSE auth, multi-sheet export, legacy layout). Frontend: all refactored components render correctly — JobHeader shows title/location/status, PlanWorkspace tabs (Plan Document / Layout Diagram / Map View) all render on approved job. Layout Diagram: schematic SVG (big canvas) renders via layoutGeometry.js extraction. Map View: Leaflet with 12 markers + 15 tiles. Plan Document: 9 headings + TMM citations. Admin modals (Knowledge Base showing 3 TMM docs / 289 chunks; ATOM Training; Users) all open and load content. Reviewer sees Approve/Reject buttons on pending jobs. Client, Reviewer, Admin logins all succeed. No React crashes, no page errors in console (only expected 401s from /api/auth/me before login). No ObjectId serialization errors.
